import platform
def mv_play():
    pro.dis_f.grid_remove()
    pro.player.del_listen(vlc.EventType.MediaPlayerEndReached)
    pro.screen.grid(row=0,column=0,sticky='nsew')
    if platform.system() == "Windows":
        pro.hwnd = pro.screen.winfo_id()
        pro.player.music_player.set_hwnd(pro.hwnd)
    elif platform.system() == "Linux":
        pro.player.music_player.set_xwindow(pro.screen.winfo_id())
    elif platform.system() == "Darwin":
        pro.player.music_player.set_nsobject(pro.screen.winfo_id())
    x = pro.player.music_message.get('name','')
    if x and pro.music_dict.get(x).get('video') != 'no<>found':
        pro.player.set_media_path_mv(x,pro.music_dict.get(x,'').get('video'))
    
def back_music():
    pro.screen.grid_remove()
    pro.dis_f.grid()
pro.menu.add_command(label='mv',command=mv_play)
pro.menu.add_command(label='music',command=back_music)
pro.screen = ttkbootstrap.Canvas(pro.app)
